description: This file defines the StreamHandler class in the OrangeHRM installation framework, extending Monolog's StreamHandler to add conditional log writing based on HTTP kernel log file writability.

classes.name: StreamHandler
classes.description: A custom stream handler extending Monolog's StreamHandler that only writes logs if the HTTP kernel's log file is writable.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides the parent write method to include a check for log file writability before proceeding.
